metrics.definition: Fraction of independently annotated page, annotation, geometry, action-class, tag-presence, and render-extent facts matched by acquisition output.
Fraction of public corpus cases executed through the PDF process adapter and public SightLint binary.
Expected failed bounds verdicts divided by all emitted failed bounds verdicts in this public corpus.
Fraction of declared non-rectangular activation cases retaining cantTell rather than receiving a core hitBox.
Fraction of clean and hard-negative cases with any unexpected failed verdict.
Fraction of targeted mutations producing their independently declared failed hitBox target.

nonClaims: These targets are regression expectations for three public generated cases, not estimates of real-world PDF accuracy.
No protected holdout, independent annotation, text or tag interpretation, paint geometry, rendered node identity, or PDF-specific rule is evaluated.
A source annotation rectangle outside a CropBox does not by itself prove a user-facing defect in every PDF viewer.
